positions.pos: Outside flows, inside nests. Every wall inside a ship is an older skin it grew past and kept, so walls follow the skin's curve and the chambers mirror around a heart chamber the way the skin mirrors around its axis. Every floor sits at one height and one walk passes a gate in every wall; stairs only go down to the stores. Older walls look worn, the newest skin fresh. Option A on round 5's page (nested rings) is the recommended layout for the living ship.
positions.why: Your note on boat-grid-look-4 (2026-10-24): compartments, balance inner and outer symmetry with crew moving coherently, keep the transcend and include. The art director check preferred nested rings over a growth line because only the rings answer all four.
